$schema: Proxy Front-End Lane Annotation Schema v1

info.description: H-PROXY1 ego-lane corridor ground truth for 100 target-domain frames

left_boundary.coordinates: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2], ...] — ordered from bottom-of-frame (y=max) to top

ego_corridor.description: Polygon bounded by left_boundary + right_boundary + bottom edge + top of drivable area
ego_corridor.type: Polygon (optional, can be derived from boundaries)

lane_visibility.description: Overall lane visibility assessment for this frame

annotator_notes.description: Free-text notes about challenging conditions, unclear boundaries, etc.

frame_selection.description: 100 frames deterministically selected from the 12 windows
frame_selection.criteria: Stratified by scene type: at least 15% curves, 10% intersections, 10% occluded, 10% unclear lane markings
frame_selection.selection_method: Visual inspection of overlay images from YOLOP sanity audit → manual frame selection

required: Left boundary x < Right boundary x for all y with both defined
Polylines extend from bottom of frame (y ~= 1080) upward
For 'clear' visibility: >= 80% of frame height covered by both boundaries
For 'partial' visibility: >= 40% of frame height covered
